notes.title: Version 1.4.3 of the game Capybara Achievement Clicker
notes.notes:
Version 1.4.3 of the Game 

 Price changes and new improvements. 


 - Update of certain text in the "I". 

 -> The text of the version and the date. ( 1.3.3 -> 1.4.3 ) 


 - Increase of the particles. 

 -> 41 to 43. 


 - Unique improvements prices for click and click per second is increased. 

 -> Giga Capybara. ( 10.000$ -> 12.000$ ) 
 -> Tera Capybara. ( 50.000$ -> 55.000$ ) 
 -> Ultimate Capybara. ( 180.000$ -> 240.000$ ) 

 -> Mega Auto. ( 7.000$ -> 7.500$ ) 
 -> Giga Auto. ( 30.000$ -> 32.000$ ) 


 - 2 new unique upgrades. 

 -> The God Capybara. 
 -> And the Radioactive Capybara. 


 Good Game !

notes.title: Version 1.3.2 of the game Capybara Achievement Clicker
notes.notes:
Version 1.3.2 of the Game 

 Here is version 1.3.2 of the game, no bug fixes this time but new implementations on several aspects of the game ! 


 - Update of certain text in the "I". 

 -> The text of the version. ( 1.2.2 -> 1.3.2 ) 


 - Two new cosmetics for the Capybara. 

 -> An Axe and a Balloon. 


 - Two new improvements for the click and the click per second. 

 -> The "Ultimate Capybara" and the "Ultimate Auto" ! 


 - A secret in-game cosmetic. 


 Good Game !
